title: Trump to use Qatari plane for international trip despite security worries
description: President Donald Trump plans to fly to Ireland next week aboard the Boeing 747 gifted by Qatar. Plans to take the plane out of service to upgrade its security have slipped to later this fall.

title: Ken Paxton and the politics of timepieces
description: Ken Paxton campaigned while wearing a very expensive watch, some political observers believe. Will it hurt his race?

title: ICE agent charged with lying to investigators in nonfatal Minneapolis shooting
description: The case is the first known instance of the Justice Department seeking to prosecute a federal immigration officer for actions taken during the Minneapolis operation.

title: Court throws out Missouri congressional map, helping Democrats keep seat
description: In addition, Maryland’s high court cleared the way for voters to decide in November whether to back a plan to eliminate a GOP-held seat in 2028.

title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to allow mail-in ballot restrictions
description: The question of whether President Donald Trump’s restrictions can move forward in time for November’s midterm elections has been the subject of a dizzying legal battle in recent weeks.

title: Secret Service is getting the fortified White House that past presidents resisted
description: President Donald Trump has backed plans including permanently fencing Lafayette Square that were previously rejected to maintain public access to the “People’s House.”

title: Trump officials say work will start on triumphal arch within two weeks
description: The planned 250-foot-tall structure near Arlington National Cemetery is one of the president’s top construction priorities.

title: Connecticut senator urges Democrats to speak up about fighting corporate power
description: As Chris Murphy walks the length of his state for the 10th time, he warned that those in his party must tell voters how the economy benefits the ultrarich.

title: Vance says he doesn’t know when Iran conflict will end — it’s up to Iran
description: The vice president also defended Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth from recent criticism.

title: The Trump administration still aims to make state citizenship lists ahead of midterms
description: The Trump administration is taking the unprecedented step of creating lists of adult citizens who are eligible to vote in each state – but will not meet its own deadline 60 days before Election Day.

title: GOP-led House scraps two weeks of work ahead of midterms
description: The move gives candidates more time to sell themselves to voters. It means little, if any, legislation is likely to pass Congress before November.

title: Leon Black defies subpoena to testify in Epstein inquiry and sues House panel
description: The billionaire investor is under two subpoenas from the House Oversight Committee. But in his lawsuit, Black says the panel doesn't have the authority to compel him to share nondisclosure agreements.

title: What to watch for when voting in the midterms
description: The Justice Department plans to send 1,000 monitors to polls and voting by mail could be tricky if you don’t plan ahead.

title: Republicans fear Trump will keep super PAC money and not spend on the midterms
description: President Donald Trump has kept most of his super PAC money on the sidelines and been reticent on his spending plans, worrying Republicans ahead of this fall’s elections.

title: Billionaire Leon Black ignores Epstein investigation subpoena, sues congressional committee
description: Black was a client of Epstein’s; he’s sued the House Oversight Committee over its Epstein investigation after ignoring a subpoena.

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to lift block on USPS plan to restrict mail voting
description: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to lift a temporary block on the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's attempt to restrict mail-in voting for the midterm election.

title: Trump encouraged Army secretary to stay in job
description: The president suggested to Dan Driscoll, who clashed with the defense secretary, that he could stay through the midterms, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Secret Service hasn’t updated some policies in 30 years, review finds
description: The agency encountered drones for years without revising its policies until the 2024 assassination attempt on Donald Trump.

title: The places where the government has put Trump’s name and face
description: President Donald Trump’s administration has put his name on more than a dozen buildings, documents, government items and programs during his second term.

title: Elon Musk’s super PAC enters the midterms with Senate race spending
description: After unleashing $260 million in 2024, America PAC is beginning to spend again.

title: Independents aren’t just undercover partisans after all
description: Plus: Why people are drinking less, and whose best friend is a chatbot?

title: Tributes to Gloria Steinem are flooding in, from Hollywood to Capitol Hill
description: Women in politics and pop culture are paying tribute to Gloria Steinem after her death at 92. Many called her not only an inspiration but a friend.

title: ICE officer faces federal charges for lying over shooting of Venezuelan immigrant
description: The charges represent a rare moment of the Justice Department seeking to hold immigration officers accountable.

title: Fox News abruptly parts ways with scandal-tarred star Maria Bartiromo
description: Fox News abruptly announced it had cut ties with anchor Maria Bartiromo after more than a dozen years.

title: Judge blocks Trump’s latest attempt to limit birthright citizenship
description: The judge said the issue raised in Trump’s August executive order was settled by the Supreme Court, and “no Presidential Executive Order can undo what the Supreme Court has done.”

title: How the data center backlash is growing in U.S. statehouses
description: Legislation is being introduced at a record pace as growing public opposition to data centers drives more proposals to restrict the tech giants.

title: Republicans court debate on expanding the Supreme Court
description: In recent years, Democrats have fumed over how Republicans have handled Supreme Court nominations.

title: Democrats demand Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of midterms
description: The lawmakers wrote that they share "grave concern that time is running out … to assist state and local election officials in protecting our elections from cyber and mis-and disinformation threats."

title: Inside the failed mission to eliminate FEMA
description: David Richardson worked to eliminate the country's top disaster agency when he led FEMA last year. Now, he says the administration has abandoned that goal.

title: Veteran political journalist on division among Democrats over democratic socialism
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with CNN senior political analyst Ron Brownstein about the Democratic Party's division over embracing democratic socialism.

title: Ex-National Security Council director on administration's plan for Venezuela oil
description: NPR's Michel Martin asks former Obama administration official Benjamin Gedan about the viability of the Trump administration's plan for Venezuelan oil.

title: Maduro seeks to fend off narco-terrorism trial, arguing he has immunity
description: Deposed Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro launched a sweeping attack on the U.S. criminal case against him, urging a judge to dismiss the charges as an an unlawful effort to prosecute a foreign head of state.

title: FAA wants to permanently restrict planes over Mar-a-Lago, long a Trump complaint
description: The rules would affect flights traveling into and out of the nearby airport recently renamed after the president.

title: Plane carrying DHS Secretary Mullin makes emergency landing after engine failure
description: The pilot told air traffic controllers in the Washington area that the airplane had 14 people on board. Mullin said the single-engine landing went smoothly.

title: U.S. Mint puts golden $1 coin with Trump’s image into circulation
description: The coins, meant to mark America’s 250th birthday, will also be sold on the Mint website at markups spanning roughly 50 percent to nearly 150 percent over their face value.

title: El-Sayed blames Trump for global bond market sell-off
description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed blamed “Trump’s mismanagement” for a global sell-off in bonds in this week.

title: Senate Majority Leader John Thune warns Republicans could lose the Senate
description: Democrats have grown more optimistic about their chances as President Donald Trump’s approval rating has declined.

title: What to know about Abdul El-Sayed
description: Democrats’ most controversial Senate candidate is in a must-win race for the party.

title: Orlando held a fight in its city-owned arena. Then came the Nazi salutes.
description: Organizers booked a kickboxer who served time in federal prison, after prosecutors said he pushed a “race-based civil war,” to fight a Jewish opponent.

title: Chevron makes its own deal to double Venezuelan production
description: The major oil company has plans to invest $7 billion as Trump aligns with its largest competitor in Venezuela.

title: Watch Ontario, New York, residents sound off on the Lake America name change
description: In a Trump-voting town named after Lake Ontario, residents have strong feelings about the president rechristening it to Lake America.
